unit: per home (average declared fair market value)
note: Average declared fair market value of residential property transfers (total value / number of transfers) in the 3- and 12-month windows ending 2026-07-31; n is the number of residential transfers. median, low, high, min and max all repeat the average because BC publishes no median or percentiles. Areas: ALL (province), rd|<regional district>, m|<municipality or rural area>.
